items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Oscar and Elon Watkins and I believe it was Thomas Ross, he's a trumpet player

ctx.x: Usually now one guy--but you need more than just one man, I think Oscar Estelle was in the band, that's why we did finally make it and talking about Tulsa, you take Spurgeon, Earl Bostic, came up through high school under William Jett and they would always find the little bandstand out of the military band; then my brother came--the one that I was telling you when I first came out of school in Sand Springs, he moved into Tulsa and was a band director of high school, and really, Clarence Little was one guy that…
Oscar and Elon Watkins and I believe it was Thomas Ross, he's a trumpet player, he never did get to make it, he got into bad health, drinking, but was a very fine
musician--Thomas Ross--and he was a nice writer too. I think I have one of the old pictures that he was in.
